_network_type: SNN autoencoder (dense pre-processor with spiking neurons)
_architecture_summary: Encoder: input→Linear(64)→Leaky(SNN)→Linear(32)→latent z. Decoder: z→Linear(64)→Leaky(SNN)→Linear(output)→reconstruct. Surrogate: exponential. Biophysical params: R,C learnable & clamped 1e-6.
_loss_function: Spike-time loss (first spike latency decoding) + spike regularization
_preprocessing: Window 256 (1s@256Hz), encodings: direct, Poisson, latency. v_th sweep [0.5,1.0,1.5], α decay sweep [0.8,0.9,0.99].
_total_runs_breakdown: 81 total = 3 encodings × 3 v_th × 3 α × 3 repeats (seeds 42,43,44). Full hyperparameter sweep for dense architecture.
_dataset_config: 100 train, 30 val (FSDD). 30 epochs max, early stop patience 5, lr 0.001 (weights), 0.0001 (SNN params), batch size 1.
_comment: SNN-AE dense: 81 runs (3 enc × 3 v_th × 3 α × 3 repeats). SNN+Leaky+spike-time loss. 100/30 data. Est. ~45 min.

experiment._comment: Experiment control: seed, repeats, determinism settings

dataset._comment: Dataset config: paths, window size, train/val sample counts, output directories

training._comment: Training hyperparams: optimizer, learning rates (weights vs biophysical), loss, epochs, early stopping

model._comment: Model architecture: SNN with dense pre-processor, layers, surrogates, biophysical params
model.encoder_description: Input → Linear(64) → Leaky-SNN(64 neurons, exponential surrogate) → Linear(32) → latent z
model.decoder_description: Latent z → Linear(64) → Leaky-SNN(64 neurons, exponential surrogate) → Linear(output) → reconstructed spikes
model.training_algorithm: BPTT with surrogate gradients, biophysical params 10x smaller lr
